title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. The dua we read, from the hadith when we go to bazar for the reward, can I read and get the same reward if I do online shopping, like in Amazon, EBay? 2572 views Q. Asalamu alaykum. I am an American Convert. Have been muslim for 1 year and 5 months now. I am currently talking to a man from Egypt regarding engagement/marriage. He's going about it the proper way by talking to my guardian (since my father is not muslim) and his parents have agreed. But now I have a big problem. I understand in Islam that women and men shouldn't talk more than business. He asked me to delete the friends from my internet accounts who I didn't even talk to. Out of respect for him and because I knew that I would need to for marriage anyway I did this. But now he still has sisters who he works with or who are students that he advises on his account. He got angry with me when I asked him if he could do the same and delete them. He said that in Egypt men are allowed to but women can't (which is impossible anyway). Is this simply a cultural issue or is there some proof in Quran and Sunnah. I know it's hard because it's over the internet, but what can I do? Is it right for him to keep his female aqaintances when I can't? I've told him my feelings and I don't like it. Another problem I have is that I can't usually read what these women comment on his profile either as it's in Arabic and I speak very little. Please help. 2240 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 11450 Country: India Title: Asalamoalaikum. My couzn gave me ear rings whch she might have won in a lottery, i am nt sure. Shud i wear dm or first ask her. Is it permissible 4 me 2 wear dm if dy r frm lottery? Question: Asalamoalaikum. My couzn gave me ear rings whch she might have won in a lottery, i am nt sure. Shud i wear dm or first ask her. Is it permissible 4 me 2 wear dm if dy r frm lottery? Answer ID: 11450 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 407/367=B/1430) Lottery is a kind of gambling, if you won the earrings in the lottery it is not allowed to wear it. If they earrings were bought or gifted by someone, then you can wear them. You should enquire about it first. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
